summary: Verified 2026-10 admin-bypass & fulfillment-plan features. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (auth baseline, GET /api/sales-admin/orders/{id}/fulfillment-plan as admin and salesadmin with correct shape; POST plan validations 400 for total>shortage, all-zero, stock>own, wait>incoming; admin can approve own PO (SoD bypass OK); non-admin manager still 403/SoD-blocked). Live probing of demo order so_23cd0fac9eb6 confirmed shortage=235, own_available=85, incoming_total=400 per spec. Admin PO approve on PO with chain=[level 1, manager] succeeded (status pending, approval_status=approved) with no SoD block. Frontend smoke: login as admin, Meja Admin Sales loads, 'Pemenuhan' button opens fulfill-dialog with all required testids (fulfill-dialog, fulfill-line-<pid>, fulfill-short-<pid>, fulfill-stock-<pid>, fulfill-stock-<pid>-max, fulfill-reorder-<pid>, fulfill-reorder-<pid>-max, fulfill-wait-<pid>, fulfill-wait-<pid>-max, fulfill-left-<pid>, fulfill-note, fulfill-cancel, fulfill-submit). Submit disabled when all zero (observed Rp-less 'Jalankan rencana' with disabled styling). The fulfill-ic-<pid>-<entityId> row is conditionally rendered only when other_entities has stock (demo SO had none) — behaviour consistent with spec. fulfill-history row renders only when past decisions exist. Code-review of backend/services/sales_order_helpers.py reserve_roll_mode_item (lines 123-181) confirms cross-entity roll selections now populate result['proposals'] (no auto warehouse_transfers / auto_from_order creation).
critical_code_review_comments: sales_order_helpers.reserve_roll_mode_item correctly removes auto-transfer path and emits proposals[]; verified at lines 150-181.
approval_matrix_service.evaluate() sets admin_bypass=True and sod_blocked() short-circuits for admin — matches request.
purchase_orders.approve route (around lines 775-870) iterates every pending level when actor is admin — single admin approve clears multi-level chains.
fulfillment_plan router has required-permission guard order.confirm and uses _assert_may_choose_source only when interco present (good).
